net_worth_definition.name: disclosed net worth range
net_worth_definition.rule: low = sum of asset lows - sum of liability highs; high = sum of asset highs - sum of liability lows. Unvalued assets add 0 to low (a value is never negative) and make high null; high_valued is the same figure over valued assets only. An open-ended band ("Over $X") makes high null: the figure is then 'at least' low. Liabilities secured by a personal residence are listed but not subtracted, because the residence itself is not reported.
